title: MICRO-AMP HARDWARE DEEP SLEEP OPTIMIZATION
description: A 2-part development toolkit covering secure WiFi fallback mesh configurations and hardware-level sleep optimizations.
content:
PART 2: MICRO-AMP HARDWARE DEEP SLEEP OPTIMIZATION
Act as a low-power hardware architect. Configure an advanced deep sleep matrix for an {{ESP32 Chip Variant|*ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3}} tracking multiple sensor wake events.

The routine must implement the following power-saving parameters:
1. Isolate the internal Real-Time Clock (RTC) domain, shutting down all non-essential internal rails to drop current consumption below {{Target Microamps: 15}}uA.
2. Configure external wake-up triggers using the RTC GPIO pins, enabling an active-low wake sequence on Pin {{Wake Pin: GPIO_NUM_4}} from an attached PIR or accelerometer.
3. Cache crucial state parameters inside the `RTC_DATA_ATTR` memory segment so data persists across sleep boundaries without writing to flash wear cycles.
